status: prospective verifier correction; no efficacy training authorized
scope: Engineering-gate code and receipt validation only.

audit_findings.failure: The post-update verifier required query hashes to remain unchanged at every attention layer.
audit_findings.cause: An adapted earlier layer is expected to change the feature passed as the query to later layers. The invariant was over-broad.
audit_findings.correction: Require the initial query to match at layer 0 and require stored keys, values, positions, and pointers to remain unchanged at every layer. Keep exact full-model parity as a separate zero-strength check.

audit_findings.finding: The verifier used an unimported tempfile module and checked captured sample count against the raw optional CLI argument.
audit_findings.correction: Import tempfile and compare against the resolved clip length frozen by the protocol.

audit_findings.finding: The verifier constructed all required completion booleans as true after reaching the end of main.
audit_findings.correction: Derive each required check from recorded parity, layer, geometry, gradient, bank, initialization, prediction-write, resume, and persistent-ID assertions; reject missing or false checks.

audit_findings.finding: The gate receipt did not bind the exact efficacy amendment and all current runner sources, so a later changed schedule or implementation could be paired with an older gate.
audit_findings.correction: Bind the efficacy-amendment hash, manifest, SAM2 revision, environment, and runner source inventory in the gate setup and compare them with the planned training run before accepting the receipt.

audit_findings.finding: The synthetic multi-object fixture treated NumPy's nonzero() coordinate tuple as a PyTorch tensor.
audit_findings.correction: Use NumPy argwhere/median to split the visible prompt mask and validate the two nonempty synthetic object regions before propagation.

required: Focused adapter, training-path, runner, verifier, receipt, and provenance tests pass.
The corrected seq2/seq3 gate runs in a new Drive output directory and derives all required checks from observed assertions.
The training runner rejects the previous partial receipt and any receipt whose frozen amendment, data, environment, SAM2 revision, or shared source hashes differ.
validation.limitation: Passing this engineering gate establishes implementation integrity on fixed short clips only. It does not establish a Dice gain or natural multi-object efficacy.
